trigger: Previous turn user challenged whether the proposal faithfully represented accumulated discussion.
title: LLM 서비스의 Eco 명칭과 성능 양보 수용에 관한 연구계획서
central_question: LLM 서비스에서 같은 낮은 연산 옵션을 Light 대신 Eco라고 부르면, 환경적 의미의 해석과 모드 선택, 성능 양보의 수용은 어떻게 달라지는가?
authoring: Root-authored proposal; no new persona dialogue, review or score. User approval of final wording/design not assumed.
major_changes: Opening restores motivation: willingness to give up some AI performance for expected environmental benefit, then asks what the Eco name changes in an LLM effort menu.
Prior work is connected to the move from usage/nature feedback toward naming the option chosen before use, while acknowledging existing mode-choice and quality-perception research.
Light versus Eco randomized label comparison remains a proposed first study with identical descriptions, other menu choices and authored response examples.
Old product-selection correctness and R/Q/X stimuli are removed from v3 and replaced by writing, information organization and ideation examples.
Both output examples retain factual correctness; variations concern structure, elaboration and diversity. Conciseness or acceptance alone is not automatically classified as performance sacrifice.

Independent pilot evaluates unlabeled output utility. Final choice, reported insufficiency and comparative usefulness are recorded separately without conditioning the causal comparison on a post-treatment subgroup.
Every assigned participant evaluates common examples after an explicit transition regardless of initial mode choice. A High-labeled alternative is identical between naming groups.

First-task low-option selection is primary; task order balanced between groups; repeated judgments secondary. Environmental beliefs and reasons are post-experience reports, not proven causal mediators.

Execution includes a proposed 6–10 person pilot and a transparent illustrative main-sample calculation. Per-group 163 under assumed .30/.45 proportions, two-sided .05 alpha and .80 power is not a measured baseline or approved final N.
Physical environmental benefit and development slowdown remain separate follow-up questions. No real inference-setting 2×2 or quality-noninferiority success requirement.
